in_marathi.name: Arvinda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Arvinda means 'Arising in the mind'
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arvinda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Arvinda is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arvind'. It refers to one who arises in the mind, and is often associated with spiritual awakening and enlightenment.
